universe.name: Macro photography of handmade miniature sets
universe.why: Grounds the abstract 'internet' into tangible, physical, vulnerable wires that viewers can almost touch, emphasizing how fragile our global connection really is.
universe.pacing: Methodical and tactile, smoothly gliding through the miniature world until the sudden, chaotic snap.
universe.signature_shot: The tiny felt penguin desperately trying to tape two massive, sparking ends of a garden-hose cable together with a roll of miniature duct tape.
universe.medium_break: In the opening shot, the 'starry sky' is visibly a piece of black cardboard held up by a giant strip of masking tape stuck to a wooden workbench.
universe.look_bible: Macro photography of miniature handmade sets built from actual electronics, wire, resin, and household objects. Deep depth of field drop-off (macro bokeh) keeps foreground and background elements out of focus to emphasize small scale. Cinematic miniature lighting, rich saturated oceanic blues, neon fiber-optic glows against rusty metallic textures. Fluid motion control camera glides.
universe.penguin_render: A tiny handmade felt-and-wire miniature penguin wearing a yellow plastic hard hat. Egg-shaped, big white eye-rings, small dark beak with orange tip, orange feet, three stubborn wire feathers sticking out under the hard hat.
universe.music: Plucky synth arpeggios mixed with ticking clockwork mechanisms and deep ambient cello.

penguin.arc: The planet's smallest, most overworked cable-repair technician who tries to tape the internet back together and ultimately gets blown away by a spark.

shots.motion: Crane down past the foil satellite, descending smoothly to the dark resin ocean floor to reveal the glowing cable.
Fast push-in tracking along the thick glowing cable until we find the penguin riding it.
Snap pan right as the giant anchor crashes down, kicking up resin sand.
Camera locks off as the severed cable darkens, and bright pulses of light race through the penguin's cable.
Snap zoom out as all the cables turn red, instantly followed by them violently snapping upwards.
shots.sfx: multiple heavy cables snapping, electrical buzzing

shots.motion: Fast whip-pan straight up, breaking the resin water surface to reveal the darkened miniature city.
Smooth technical pan right, sliding from the ship cross-section to the vast, empty global map.
Plunge straight down from the isolated island diorama, through the resin water, landing on the dark seabed.
Slow push-in tight on the penguin as it desperately attempts to tape the massive cables together.
Snap tilt up as the spark violently launches the penguin into the water column.
shots.sfx: loud zap, sad trombone, pathetic flapping sound

cover.prompt: Macro photography of a tiny miniature felt penguin wearing a yellow hard hat, frantically trying to wrap silver duct tape around a massive glowing green severed garden-hose cable on a dark resin ocean floor.
